subset_policy: Shuffle connectivity groups once per split/subset_seed. Take nested prefixes reaching the target row count. Never split a group. Full-data endpoint uses seed 0 once.
selection: Minimize validation RMSE, candidate ties go to the first listed candidate. Main hyperparameters selected with training seed 0, then re-fit seeds 1 and 2. Small-data contexts reselect on the same fixed validation partition. No candidate test scores are computed.

ridge.extension_rule: Evaluate extension only if initial best alpha is 1000000; stop after this one extension, flag any remaining boundary optimum.

dmpnn.extension_rule: At epoch 150, extend only when best epoch >= 130; keep optimizer state. Stop by 300, flag near-boundary best epochs.

preprocessing: Use audited shared non-stereo connectivity for GNN and LM. Reuse frozen deterministic LM embeddings. Fit all imputers, input scalers and target scalers using the selected training subset only.
reporting: Save every validation trial, selection, learning curve, selected checkpoint, val/test predictions, training membership and timing. Report mean and sample SD for training-seed replicates separately from subset-seed variation. Deterministic Ridge is not replicated on identical input. Comparisons are model pipelines, not isolated architecture effects. Current task does not claim teacher benchmark approval.
